notes: The Tiny Seed follows a seed through seasons and landscapes. Core vocabulary already contains 'small' (aac_extras) and 'cold/hot' (aac_extras) which complement this board well. The hero image needs to be specifically the Eric Carle tiny seed illustration as a generic seed PNG will not be recognisable as the book character. The journey through seasons (fall, snow, desert, ocean, mountain) is central to the plot and provides strong fringe vocabulary. 'grow' and 'big' capture the triumphant ending where the tiny seed becomes a giant flower. 'fly' and 'wind' capture the opening sequence. All 11 fringe words are high-utility for retelling and discussing this book.
